analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 RSI 60선 부근 횡보 후 금일 49.2로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램은 0.4581에서 -0.0747로 개선세 지속. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 1.58배로 증가하며 매수세 유입 가능성 시사. 다만, 주봉 RSI 44.4로 여전히 약세 구간이며 ADX 20.2로 추세 형성 초기 단계이므로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: After consolidating near the 60 level for the past 3 sessions, RSI entered oversold territory at 49.2 today, with the MACD histogram continuing its improvement from 0.4581 to -0.0747. Volume ratio at 1.58x the 5-day average suggests potential buying interest. However, weekly RSI remains weak at 44.4, and ADX is in the early stages of trend formation at 20.2, warranting a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($81.07/$86.88): In mid-to-long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (21.4%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (62.6→49.2): Exiting oversold, attempting to recover to neutral range.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.4581→-0.0747): Improvement continues, weakening bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $79.31): Consolidating near mid-band, band width narrowing to 12.45%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($75.23): Support expected based on SMA50.
· Swing resistance ($78.44): Potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Attempting Higher Low): Possibility of recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.58x): Movement gaining momentum, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Buying considered due to RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement, but maintaining a wait-and-see stance due to weekly weakness and early trend stage indicated by ADX.
